verdict.rationale: Canva is a SaaS design product with AI features, so an AI-training opt-out is a fair question to ask of it. However, nothing in the evidence pack documents any setting, policy, or control that keeps user data out of AI model training. The pack covers only developer APIs, the MCP server, SCIM, and audit logs, none of which address this.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
